component.name: nextcloud-hpb
component.description: TAPPaaS module nextcloud-hpb: triage of its own critical/high CVEs (#788). nextcloud-spreed-signaling 2.1.1 (in-process NATS, :8080 behind Caddy, internal zones by default) and Janus 1.4.1 (videoroom plugin and loopback websockets transport only, RTP on UDP 20000-20999, reachable from dmz for coturn) run on the VM; no recording server runs here. Live check: ffmpeg-8.1.2-lib is referenced only by janus-gateway's janus-pp-rec and mjr2pcap binaries, the running janus process does not map any libav*, libssh, libtiff or gstreamer library, and no unit or timer calls those tools. libssh and libtiff reach the closure only through that ffmpeg; gstreamer core (no plugin packages at all) only through libnice's gstreamer element, which janus does not load.

analysis.detail: ffmpeg 8.1.2 is linked only by janus-pp-rec and mjr2pcap (offline recording post-processors); the running janus does not map it, recordplay is disabled and no unit or timer runs those tools.
